user.title: TMD WRF Forecast
user.description: Forecast from the WRF model of the Thai Meteorological Department (3 km, hourly for 3 days, then 3-hourly up to 7 days). The location must lie in Thailand or its neighbouring areas. Unofficial integration, not affiliated with TMD.

error.cannot_connect: The TMD server could not be reached. Try again later.
error.outside_domain: This location is outside the TMD model area (Thailand and neighbouring areas).

abort.already_configured: This location is already set up.
